# anyscale_role_binding (Resource)

~> **Alpha.** Role bindings are an Alpha feature behind a feature flag (contact [support@anyscale.com](mailto:support@anyscale.com) for access) and may change in breaking ways before Beta, even in a minor release. See the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md#role-bindings-alpha).

Grants one role to one user group or user on an organization, cloud or project. Access granted this way is not visible to `anyscale_cloud_access`; see the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md). A binding cannot be edited, so changing any argument replaces it. Requires an organization [converted to role bindings](../guides/rbac.md#organization-access-mode).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Alpha, behind a feature flag (contact support@anyscale.com for
# access). The schema may change before Beta. Grants one role to one
# user group or one user on exactly one of a cloud, a project, or the
# organization. A binding cannot be edited: changing any argument
# replaces it.
#
# Prefer groups: grant a role to a group once, then change who has
# access by editing the group's members.
variable "project_id" {
  description = "ID of an existing Anyscale project (prj_...)"
  type        = string
}

variable "org_role_name" {
  description = "Exact, case-sensitive name of a grantable role"
  type        = string
}

data "anyscale_role" "project_viewer" {
  name = "project_viewer" # exact, case-sensitive
}

resource "anyscale_user_group" "analysts" {
  name = "analysts"
}

# Who is in the group. AUTHORITATIVE: anyone not listed is removed from
# the group. Each email must already belong to your organization.
resource "anyscale_user_group_members" "analysts" {
  user_group_id = anyscale_user_group.analysts.id
  members = [
    "alice@example.com",
    "bob@example.com",
  ]
}

# What the group may do: every member gets project_viewer on this
# project.
resource "anyscale_role_binding" "analysts_project_viewer" {
  user_group_id = anyscale_user_group.analysts.id
  role_id       = data.anyscale_role.project_viewer.id
  # exactly one of cloud_id, project_id, organization_id
  project_id = var.project_id

  # Avoid a window with no access when role_id changes.
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# Directory-synced (SCIM) groups can't be managed by Terraform, but they
# can hold a role binding. Here every member of the group gets the role
# across the whole organization.
data "anyscale_user_group" "okta_admins" {
  name = "okta-admins"
}

data "anyscale_organization" "current" {}

data "anyscale_role" "org_role" {
  name = var.org_role_name
}

resource "anyscale_role_binding" "okta_admins_org" {
  user_group_id   = data.anyscale_user_group.okta_admins.id
  role_id         = data.anyscale_role.org_role.id
  organization_id = data.anyscale_organization.current.id
}

# Alternative: bind a single user or service account (usr_...) with
# user_id instead of user_group_id. Use the data source's user_id, not
# its id.
data "anyscale_organization_user" "carol" {
  email = "carol@example.com"
}

resource "anyscale_role_binding" "carol_project_viewer" {
  user_id    = data.anyscale_organization_user.carol.user_id
  role_id    = data.anyscale_role.project_viewer.id
  project_id = var.project_id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) The role to grant (`rol_...`); look one up by name with the `anyscale_role` data source. Changing it replaces the binding, leaving the principal without the role in between unless the resource sets `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }`.

### Optional

- `cloud_id` (String) Grant the role on this cloud. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `organization_id` (String) Grant the role on the organization: the token's own, as returned by the `anyscale_organization` data source. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `project_id` (String) Grant the role on this project. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `user_group_id` (String) The user group that holds the role (`ug_...`). Groups synced from an identity provider are accepted. Specify exactly one of `user_group_id` or `user_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `user_id` (String) The user that holds the role (`usr_...`); look up an organization member by email with the `anyscale_organization_user` data source. Service accounts are users too (`usr_...`). Specify exactly one of `user_group_id` or `user_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the grant was made.
- `created_by` (String) The ID of the user who made the grant. Null when the API does not know.
- `id` (String) The role binding ID (`rb_...`).
- `origin` (String) How the grant was made, as the API records it, for example `imperative`. Null when the API does not know.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by what the binding grants:
#   <scope_type>/<scope_id>/<principal_type>/<principal_id>/<role_id>
#   scope_type is organization, cloud or project; principal_type is user
#   or user_group. Fails, and creates nothing, if no such binding
#   exists.
terraform import anyscale_role_binding.analysts_project_viewer project/prj_abc123/user_group/ug_abc123/rol_abc123

# Or by the role binding ID (rb_...), for a binding held by a user group
# or by a user.
terraform import anyscale_role_binding.analysts_project_viewer rb_abc123
```
